steps.name: Add the pure standings module and goal-difference format
criteria: standings(clubs, played) returns one StandingRow per club with exactly the 11 keys position, clubId, name, played, won, drawn, lost, goalsFor, goalsAgainst, goalDifference, points; order is Pts, GD, goals for descending, then name ascending by code point (a space before a letter); positions 1..8
The seed-31 matchday-1 results give Tarnbeck Borough first on +4 with 3 points and Netherwold Borough sixth on -1 with 0; with no match played every row is zero in A to Z order

Row rules W+D+L=P, Pts=3W+D, GD=GF-GA and the totals (W=L, D even, GD 0) hold for any input, results in any order give the same table, inputs are never mutated, a home or away that is not a club index throws RangeError
formatGoalDifference writes +N, 0 (also for -0) and -N with ASCII U+002D; standings.ts has no localeCompare, toLocale, Intl, Math.random, Date or performance.now and imports only the Club type

criteria: playMatchday({ seed, matchday, sides }) returns the 4 PlayedMatch entries of fixturesOf(matchday) in fixture index order, each result exactly playMatch on its own stream, with no new RNG stream and no change to playMatch or any S-006 constant

Seed 31 with all-automatic 4-4-2 sides gives 1–2, 2–2, 5–1 and 1–3 with Sam's match Netherwold Borough 1–2 Marlbrook Athletic; seed 20260 fixture 0 is Harrowgate Lane United 0–1 Oakhampton Rise Borough
Changing one club's eleven leaves the three fixtures without it unchanged; playing twice with frozen sides is deep-equal and mutates nothing; entries survive a JSON round trip
Sides not 8 and a matchday not an integer 1..14 throw RangeError; matchdays 1 and 14 work

steps.name: Record matchday 1 on the first Play match and add the table screen state, renderer and shell case
criteria: GameState gains optional results (absent key in initialState and every never-played state); the first PlayMatch sets results to state.results ?? playOpeningMatchday(state, clubId) (Sam's side currentXI, every other side automatic 4-4-2) and changes only screen otherwise; later taps keep the very same array; NewGame drops results, xi and picks

ViewTable is valid only from the club home of a known club and Back from the table of a known club returns to the club home with the whole state as it was; every other screen, action or unknown club returns the very same state object

matchFor reads the recorded matchday-1 entry (the recorded result object itself) and returns only { matchday, home: { club, squad }, away: { club, squad }, result } with no xi (U-5); standingsOf(state) is standings(league.clubs, results ?? []); after playing, formation, pick and visit taps never change the table or Sam's match (K3)

focusPlan puts the table in the same-club group (heading focus on arrival and on Back); sameScreen and back are refactored with a sameClub helper and a set of home-returning kinds so oxlint complexity stays at or under 15 (U-4)

src/ui/screens/table.ts renders a native table named by its heading (th scope col and row, Club as rowheader, 7 cells per body row, aria-current on the managed club's row, GD text via formatGoalDifference, textContent only, a single Back button, never moves focus) and src/main.ts gets the table case in the same commit to satisfy the never guard; the Table button is not added yet

steps.name: Add the Table button, table CSS with highlight token, design-system pattern and e2e (U-1)
criteria: The club home shows exactly five buttons in the order Squad, Tactics, Starting XI, Play match, Table, all 44px or taller; Table opens the League table screen in 1 tap (2 taps from the match via Back), all 8 rows present on arrival with the heading focused, Back returns to the club home heading

The table fits 390px with no horizontal scroll before and after matchday 1, the Club cell wraps, Sam's row is highlighted through a --highlight token, no display is set on any table part and no text-transform is used (U-3 review item); no console errors across the journey
